title: On Symmetry for Characterizing Agent Heterogeneity in Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: 论对称性：多智能体系统中智能体异质性的特征分析

paragraphs.en: Understanding agent heterogeneity can inform the design of shared and agent-specific policy representations, however existing criteria provide no unified structural test. We study finite-horizon POSGs and define a type-compatible transformation as a policy-evaluation symmetry when complete policy evaluation commutes with it for every decentralized behavioral policy. Policy-evaluation symmetries form a group for which agent orbits define structural agent types. This classification does not depend on the particular policy chosen or the distribution of initial states. We prove that every componentwise environment automorphism is a policy-evaluation symmetry, but that the converse does not hold. Applying the framework to cooperative Dec-POMDPs shows that agents can belong to different structural types even when they share a common reward. For prescribed weighted reward aggregation, we derive an exact value identity and sufficient conditions for the resulting Dec-POMDP to inherit the policy-evaluation symmetries of the source POSG. Finally, we give sufficient conditions under which repeated model factorizations induce policy-evaluation symmetry, and show that preserving an optimal Boltzmann policy set neither implies nor follows from this symmetry in general.
paragraphs.zh: 理解智能体异质性可以为共享和特定智能体的策略表示设计提供指导，然而现有标准并未提供任何统一的结构性检验方法。 我们研究了有限视界的 POSG，并将类型兼容的变换定义为一种策略评估对称性：当完整的策略评估与这种变换对每个去中心化的行为策略均可交换时，即满足该定义。 策略评估对称性构成一个群，其中智能体轨道定义了结构性的智能体类型。 这种分类不依赖于所选择的特定策略或初始状态的分布。 我们证明了每个分量级环境自同构都是策略评估对称性，但反之则不成立。 将该框架应用于合作性 Dec-POMDP 表明，即使智能体共享相同的奖励，它们也可能属于不同的结构性类型。 对于给定的加权奖励聚合方式，我们推导出了一个精确的值恒等式，以及源 POSG 的策略评估对称性被继承到所生成的 Dec-POMDP 中的充分条件。 最后，我们给出了重复模型分解能够诱导策略评估对称性的充分条件，并指出在一般情况下，保持最优玻尔兹曼策略集既不能推导出这种对称性，也不能由这种对称性推出。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent systems can describe interacting decision-makers in real-world problems, such as cooperative robot control ( Bettini et al., 2023 ) and voltage regulation in power distribution networks ( Wang et al., 2021 ) , where agents’ capabilities, information, objectives, and behavior may differ. As a result, characterizing these differences is necessary, which can inform the design of policy to make decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体系统能够描述现实问题中相互作用的决策者，例如协作式机器人控制（Bettini 等人，2023）和配电网络中的电压调节（Wang 等人，2021），其中智能体的能力、信息、目标和行为可能各不相同。 因此，有必要对这些差异进行描述，这可以为制定决策策略的设计提供依据。

paragraphs.en: Symmetry identifies transformations that preserve relevant system properties, a principle used across physical and computational sciences. In power-grid swing equations, exchanging generator labels preserves the dynamics when the corresponding generator parameters and network couplings are unchanged ( Molnar et al., 2021 ) . In molecular modeling, energy is invariant to rigid rotations, translations, and atom reindexing, properties incorporated into SchNet ( Schütt et al., 2017 ) . These examples inspires a possibility to identify corresponding structural regularities in multi-agent systems by symmetries.
paragraphs.zh: 对称性能够识别出保持系统相关属性的变换，这一原理被广泛应用于物理和计算科学领域。 在电力系统的摆动方程中，如果对应的发电机参数和网络耦合保持不变，交换发电机的标签并不会改变其动态特性（Molnar 等，2021）。 在分子建模中，能量对于刚性旋转、平移和原子重新索引是不变的，这些属性已被整合到 SchNet 模型中（Schütt 等，2017）。 这些例子启发了一种可能性：通过对称性来识别多智能体系统中的对应结构规律。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), as a learning framework for multi-agent systems, already exploits symmetry. Distributed policy networks that encode global symmetries empirically improve data efficiency on symmetric cooperative tasks ( van der Pol et al., 2022 ) . Other-play uses environment symmetries to reduce dependence on arbitrary conventions in zero-shot coordination ( Hu et al., 2020 ) , while expected return symmetries extend the symmetry class used for this purpose ( Muglich et al., 2025 ) . However, their focus is task-specific (improving learning and coordination), leaving the connection to structural agent heterogeneity an open question.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）作为一种面向多智能体系统的学习框架，已经利用了对称性。 经验表明，能够编码全局对称性的分布式策略网络可以提升对称性协作任务中的数据效率（van der Pol 等，2022）。 Other-play 方法利用环境中的对称性来减少零样本协调中对任意约定规则的依赖（Hu 等，2020），而期望回报对称性则扩展了用于此目的的对称性类别（Muglich 等，2025）。 然而，它们的研究重点局限于特定任务（提升学习和协调能力），因此其与智能体结构性异质性的关联仍是一个未解问题。

paragraphs.en: Broader formal accounts describe component-preserving model automorphisms ( Kang and Kim, 2012 ; Treutlein et al., 2021 ) . Braun et al. ( Braun et al., 2022 ) use counting and isomorphic symmetries for compact partitioned Dec-POMDPs, with agent-number tractability relying on the stronger isomorphic factorization. Complementary work classifies physical and behavioral heterogeneity in multi-robot learning ( Bettini et al., 2023 ) , measures behavioral differences through system neural diversity ( Bettini et al., 2025 ) , and distinguishes observation, transition, objective, and policy heterogeneity ( Hu et al., 2026 ) . These perspectives identify particular model regularities or dimensions of difference, however, they are still with a gap to the chracteristics of multi-agent systems.
paragraphs.zh: 更广泛的正式理论描述了保留组件的模型自同构（Kang 和 Kim，2012；Treutlein 等，2021）。Braun 等 （Braun 等，2022）对紧凑的分区 Dec-POMDP 使用了计수와同构对称性，其中智能体数量的可处理性依赖于更强的同构分解。 互补的研究则对多机器人学习中的物理和行为异质性进行了分类（Bettini 等，2023），通过系统的神经多样性衡量行为差异（Bettini 等，2025），并区分了观测、转移、目标和策略的异质性（Hu 等，2026）。 这些视角识别出了特定的模型规律性或差异维度，然而，它们与多智能体系统的特性之间仍存在差距。

paragraphs.en: We therefore ask: can we use symmetries to determine structural agent heterogeneity? Specifically, when can agents be exchanged through compatible transformations without changing how every decentralized policy is evaluated?
paragraphs.zh: 因此我们提出一个问题：我们能否利用对称性来确定智能体的结构性异质性？ 具体来说，在什么情况下，可以通过兼容的变换交换智能体，而不会改变每一项去中心化政策的评估方式？

sents.en: We therefore ask: can we use symmetries to determine structural agent heterogeneity?
sents.zh: 因此我们提出一个问题：我们能否利用对称性来确定智能体的结构性异质性？

sents.en: Specifically, when can agents be exchanged through compatible transformations without changing how every decentralized policy is evaluated?
sents.zh: 具体来说，在什么情况下，可以通过兼容的变换交换智能体，而不会改变每一项去中心化政策的评估方式？

paragraphs.en: To answer the above research questions, we ground our theoretical framework in finite-horizon partially observable stochastic games (POSGs). A transformation is a policy-evaluation symmetry if evaluating any transformed policy gives the correspondingly transformed value profile, at every state–joint-history pair. These symmetries form a group whose agent orbits define structural agent types : one orbit means structural homogeneity, and multiple orbits mean structural heterogeneity. For the specified game and admissible transformations, this classification is independent of the selected policy and initial-state distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 为回答上述研究问题，我们将理论框架建立在有限视域的部分可观测随机博弈（POSGs）之上。 如果任何经过变换的策略在每一个状态-联合历史组合中都能产生相应变换的价值分布，那么这种变换就是一种策略评估对称性。 这些对称性构成一个群，其智能体轨道定义了结构智能体类型：一个轨道意味着结构同质性，而多个轨道则意味着结构异质性。 对于指定的博弈和可接受的变换，这种分类与所选策略及初始状态分布无关。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are as follows: (1) We establish the policy-evaluation symmetry group and its structural agent types, allowing compatible agent, state, action, and observation transformations. We distinguish policy-evaluation symmetry, which concerns every decentralized policy, from the equivariance of a selected policy. (2) We prove that preserving the transition, observation, and reward functions componentwise guarantees policy-evaluation symmetry, but the reverse is not necessary. A finite two-stage POSG yields a strictly finer componentwise agent partition to show the necessity of the policy-evaluation definition. (3) We show that Dec-POMDPs can remain structurally heterogeneous, although with a common reward. For a derived Dec-POMDP with a prescribed weighted common reward, we derive an exact weighted-value identity and sufficient conditions for inheriting the source game’s symmetries. We further compare the framework with existing heterogeneity categories, counting and isomorphic symmetry, and expected return symmetry, making the assumptions and limitations of each comparison explicit.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献如下：(1) 我们建立了策略评估对称群及其结构化的智能体类型，从而允许兼容的智能体、状态、动作和观察变换。 我们将涉及所有去中心化策略的策略评估对称性，与特定策略的等变性区分开来。 (2) 我们证明了逐分量保留转移、观察和奖励函数能够保证策略评估对称性，但反之则不必然成立。 一个有限的两阶段 POSG 会产生一个严格更精细的逐分量智能体划分，从而说明策略评估定义的必要性。 (3) 我们表明，尽管共享相同的奖励，Dec-POMDP 仍然可以保持结构上的异质性。 对于一个具有指定加权共享奖励的派生 Dec-POMDP，我们推导出了精确的加权价值恒等式，以及继承源游戏对称性的充分条件。 我们还将该框架与现有的异质性类别进行了比较，包括计数和同构对称性，以及期望回报对称性，并明确指出了各类比较的假设和局限性。

paragraphs.en: Bettini et al. ( Bettini et al., 2023 ) distinguish physical from behavioral heterogeneity in multi-robot and multi-agent systems. They further separate behavioral heterogeneity according to whether agents share an objective, yielding five physical–behavioral subclasses. This taxonomy is a high-level classification rather than a measure of degree. Their later system neural diversity measure addresses the latter question for behavior by averaging pairwise behavioral distances ( Bettini et al., 2025 ) . Hu et al. ( Hu et al., 2026 ) give a finer agent-level MARL taxonomy based on observation, response-transition, effect-transition, objective, and policy heterogeneity.
paragraphs.zh: Bettini 等人 （Bettini 等人，2023）区分了多机器人和多智能体系统中的物理异质性与行为异质性。 他们进一步根据智能体是否共享目标对行为异质性进行分类，从而得出五种物理-行为子类。 这种分类法是一种高层级的分类，而非程度上的度量。 他们后来提出的系统神经多样性度量方法通过计算成对行为距离的平均值，解决了行为方面的后一个问题（Bettini 等人，2025）。Hu 等人 （Hu 等人，2026）基于观察、响应转换、效果转换、目标和策略异质性，提出了一种更精细的智能体级 MARL 分类法。

paragraphs.en: These associations locate earlier categories within the symmetry framework, but they do not identify those categories with structural agent types. A componentwise environment automorphism that exchanges two agents guarantees that they have the same structural agent type. However, failure of a componentwise preservation equation for a candidate transformation neither rules out that transformation as a policy-evaluation symmetry nor establishes that the agents have different structural agent types. Likewise, different behavior under one selected policy does not by itself establish different structural agent types. Graded behavioral measures such as system neural diversity ( Bettini et al., 2025 ) are complementary to the structural agent-type partition. Appendix A explains the assumptions and direction of each association in Table 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 这些关联在对称性框架内定位了更早的类别，但它们并未将这些类别与结构智能体类型等同起来。 一种交换两个智能体的逐分量环境自同构，可确保这两个智能体具有相同的结构智能体类型。 然而，候选变换未能满足逐分量保持方程，既不能排除该变换作为策略评估对称性的可能性，也不能证明这些智能体具有不同的结构智能体类型。 同样地，在单一选定策略下的不同行为本身并不能证明存在不同的结构智能体类型。 诸如系统神经多样性（Bettini 等，2025）之类的分级行为指标，是对结构智能体类型划分的补充。 附录 A 解释了表 1 中每一项关联的假设和方向。

paragraphs.en: Symmetry in normal-form games is commonly expressed through permutations of players and strategies that preserve payoff profiles. Cao and Yang ( Cao and Yang, 2018 ) formalize player and strategy symmetry groups and distinguish ordinary, renaming, and name-irrelevant symmetric games. Koriche et al. ( Koriche et al., 2017 ) distinguish structural symmetry from minimax symmetry in finite-horizon stochastic games. Their semantic notion preserves an optimal minimax value, whereas ours evaluates every decentralized policy in a partially observable game. Tewolde et al. ( Tewolde et al., 2025 ) study the complexity of detecting player and action symmetries in normal-form games, deriving graph-automorphism and graph-isomorphism completeness results, and analyze Nash equilibria that respect given symmetries. These traditions motivate treating agent interchangeability as an orbit question but do not directly address our all-policy setting with type-compatible state, observation, and history transformations.
paragraphs.zh: 正常形式博弈中的对称性通常通过保持支付向量不变的玩家和策略的置换来表达。 Cao 和 Yang（Cao and Yang, 2018）将玩家和策略的对称群形式化，并区分了普通对称博弈、重命名对称博弈和名称无关对称博弈。Koriche 等人 （Koriche et al., 2017）在有限时域随机博弈中区分了结构对称性与最小最大对称性。 他们的语义概念保留了最优的最小最大值，而我们的方法则评估了部分可观察博弈中的每一种去中心化策略。Tewolde 等人 （Tewolde et al., 2025）研究了正常形式博弈中检测玩家和行动对称性的复杂性，推导出了图自同构和图同构的完备性结果，并分析了尊重给定对称性的纳什均衡。 这些传统促使我们将智能体的可互换性视为一个轨道问题，但并未直接处理我们这种包含类型兼容的状态、观测和历史转换的全策略设定。

paragraphs.en: For sequential models, Kang and Kim ( Kang and Kim, 2012 ) study symmetries of POMDPs and POSGs through graph automorphisms that preserve the model components. In cooperative settings, Hu et al. ( Hu et al., 2020 ) call component-preserving transformations equivalence mappings and use them to randomize conventions in other-play. Treutlein et al. ( Treutlein et al., 2021 ) formulate Dec-POMDP isomorphisms and automorphisms using bijections of agents, states, actions, and observations that preserve transitions, observations, rewards, and the initial distribution. These definitions use different model conventions and admissible transformations. After translating them into our setting, their requirements to preserve the transition, observation, and reward functions become instances of the componentwise environment automorphisms studied in Section 5 . By Theorem 5.2 , these conditions are sufficient, but not necessary, for policy-evaluation symmetry. We instead define policy-evaluation symmetry directly by ℰ ℳ ​ ( g ⋅ π ) = g ⋅ ℰ ℳ ​ ( π ) \mathcal{E}_{\mathcal{M}}(g\cdot\pi)=g\cdot\mathcal{E}_{\mathcal{M}}(\pi) for every decentralized policy π \pi : transforming a policy before evaluation must give the same value profile as evaluating it first and then transforming its values.
paragraphs.zh: 对于序列模型，Kang和Kim（Kang和Kim，2012）通过保持模型组件不变的图自同构研究了POMDP和POSG的对称性。 在合作场景中，Hu等人 （Hu等人，2020）将保持组件不变的变化称为等价映射，并利用它们来随机化其他博弈中的惯例。Treutlein等人 （Treutlein等人，2021）利用智能体、状态、动作和观测的双射来构建Dec-POMDP的同构和自同构，这些双射能够保持转移、观测、奖励和初始分布不变。 这些定义使用了不同的模型惯例和可接受的变化。 在将它们转换到我们的设定中之后，它们对保持转移、观测和奖励函数的要求，就成为了第5节所研究的按组件划分的环境自同构的特例。 根据定理5.2，这些条件对于策略评估对称性而言是充分的，但并非必要的。 我们转而通过公式 ℰ ℳ ​ ( g ⋅ π ) = g ⋅ ℰ ℳ ​ ( π ) \mathcal{E}_{\mathcal{M}}(g\cdot\pi)=g\cdot\mathcal{E}_{\mathcal{M}}(\pi) 直接定义策略评估对称性，其中 π 是任意去中心化策略：在评估前对策略进行变换，必须与先评估再对其值进行变换得到相同的值分布。

paragraphs.en: Other work captures different consequences or representations of symmetry. At the policy-architecture level, van der Pol et al. ( van der Pol et al., 2022 ) factor global cooperative-system symmetries into local transformations and agent permutations to construct distributed equivariant policy networks. This exploits a supplied symmetry in policy learning, whereas our structural agent types are defined before selecting a policy or architecture. At the representation level, Braun et al. ( Braun et al., 2022 ) use counting and isomorphic symmetry to obtain compact lifted Dec-POMDP representations. Muglich et al. ( Muglich et al., 2025 ) introduce expected return symmetries, which preserve self-play-optimal Boltzmann-exploratory policies at a fixed temperature for zero-shot coordination. Our structural agent types instead use the orbits of a solution-independent policy-evaluation symmetry group that holds for every decentralized policy.
paragraphs.zh: 其他研究捕捉了对称性的不同后果或表示形式。 在策略架构层面，van der Pol等人 （van der Pol等人，2022）将全局协作系统的对称性分解为局部变换和智能体置换，以构建分布式等变策略网络。 这种方法利用了策略学习中提供的对称性，而我们的结构性智能体类型则是在选择策略或架构之前定义的。 在表示层面，Braun等人 （Braun等人，2022）利用计数和同构对称性来获得紧凑的提升式Dec-POMDP表示。Muglich等人 （Muglich等人，2025）引入了期望回报对称性，这种对称性能够在固定温度下保持自博弈最优的玻尔兹曼探索策略，以实现零样本协作。 相比之下，我们的结构性智能体类型使用了一个与解无关的策略评估对称群的轨道，该对称群适用于所有去中心化的策略。

paragraphs.en: Agents may randomize independently at their local histories, but we exclude a common random signal, such as a shared seed or public correlation device ( Aumann, 1974 ; Bernstein et al., 2009 ) . 1 1 1 Conditioning local policies on the same random draw can produce non-product joint action laws that the factorization above cannot represent, thereby enlarging the admissible policy domain. Because policy-evaluation symmetry quantifies over this domain, admitting correlated policies can change the symmetry group and its induced structural agent types.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体可以在各自的局部历史基础上独立地进行随机化，但我们排除常见的随机信号，例如共享的种子或公共的相关性设备（Aumann, 1974；Bernstein 等，2009）。将局部策略条件于相同的随机抽取可能会产生非乘性的联合行动规律，而这些规律无法通过上述因子分解来表示，从而扩大了可接受策略域的范围。 由于策略评估对称性是对该域进行量化的，因此允许相关性策略的存在可能会改变对称群及其诱导的结构化智能体类型。

(2021) include an agent bijection; the equivalence mappings of Hu et al. (2020) and transformation group of Muglich et al. (2025) fix agent indices. Our type-compatible transformations permit agent permutations, following the former convention. such as transformations that separately preserve the transition, observation, and reward functions, appear as POSG automorphisms or symmetries ( Kang and Kim, 2012 ) , Dec-POMDP equivalence mappings ( Hu et al., 2020 ) , Dec-POMDP automorphisms ( Treutlein et al., 2021 ) , and environment symmetries ( Muglich et al., 2025 ) . We use the name componentwise environment automorphism for this notion in POSGs, emphasizing its contrast with policy-evaluation symmetry. Unlike the Dec-POMDP automorphisms of Treutlein et al. (2021) , preservation of the initial distribution is imposed separately in our framework, as we introduced in Section 4 .

paragraphs.en: Appendix B.2 constructs a full-support two-stage POSG in which exchanging the agents changes the transition distribution associated with some joint actions. The exchange is therefore not a componentwise environment automorphism. Nevertheless, the affected transition distributions produce the same expected successor-state reward and marginalized next-observation distribution. The Bellman recursion preserves complete policy evaluation under the exchange for every decentralized policy. The reward construction also rules out every alternative componentwise transformation that exchanges the agents. Hence, the componentwise partition separates the agents, whereas the policy-evaluation partition places them in one structural agent type.
paragraphs.zh: 附录 B.2 构建了一个全支持的两阶段 POSG，在该结构中，交换智能体会改变某些联合动作相关的转移分布。 因此，这种交换并非逐分量环境自同构。 尽管如此，受影响的转移分布仍会产生相同的期望后继状态奖励和边际化下一观测值分布。 贝尔曼递归在每次交换下都能保持所有去中心化策略的完整策略评估。 奖励构造也排除了所有会交换智能体的替代性逐分量变换。 因此，逐分量划分将智能体分离开来，而策略评估划分则将它们归为同一结构智能体类型。

paragraphs.en: We apply the policy-evaluation symmetry and orbit framework to two settings of Dec-POMDP ( Bernstein et al., 2002 ) . The first is a Dec-POMDP with a general common reward. The second is a derived Dec-POMDP formed by aggregating the individual rewards of a POSG.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将策略评估对称性与轨道框架应用于两种 Dec-POMDP 设置（Bernstein 等人，2002）。 第一种是具有通用共同奖励的 Dec-POMDP。 第二种是由 POSG 的个体奖励聚合而成的派生 Dec-POMDP。

paragraphs.en: This equality compares the agents’ value coordinates under the same policy and at the same state–joint-history input. However, it does not show that their decision-making roles are interchangeable. By Definition 4.2 , agents i i and j j have the same structural agent type only if some g ∈ G ℳ eval g\in G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} maps i i to j j . Such a transformation must include compatible bijections between the agents’ action and observation spaces and must preserve complete policy evaluation for every decentralized policy after exchanging the agents. A common reward alone guarantees neither these bijections nor symmetry of the transition and observation distributions. For example, in a one-stage binary-action model with the common reward r ⁡ ( a 1 , a 2 ) = a 1 r(a_{1},a_{2})=a_{1} , both agents receive the same payoff, but exchanging them changes which agent’s policy determines that payoff. The detailed proof of the above statement is given in Proposition D.1 in Appendix D .

paragraphs.en: We compare two prior frameworks with policy-evaluation symmetry, the details of which are given in Appendix E .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将两种具有策略评估对称性的先前框架进行了比较，其细节见附录 E。

paragraphs.en: In Braun et al. (2022) ’s partitioned Dec-POMDP framework, isomorphic symmetry uses identical factor templates for agents in each partition part. Under the grounding assumptions in Section E.1.1 , exchanging agents within a part together with their action and observation assignments preserves the counts in that part and only reorders equal factor instances. The grounded transition, common-reward, and observation functions are therefore unchanged, which gives counting symmetry. When these exchanges are represented by the admissible typed embedding specified there, they are componentwise environment automorphisms and hence policy-evaluation symmetries. The lifted partition therefore refines the structural agent partition. However, the two-agent coordination example we showed in Appendix E.1.1 has counting and policy-evaluation symmetry but lacks the stated repeated additive reward factorization for the same partition with one part. Policy-evaluation symmetry alone does not guarantee this repeated additive factorization. Applying Braun et al. (2022) ’s compact-representation and agent-number tractability results requires their additional factorization and computational assumptions.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Braun 等人（2022）提出的分区式 Dec-POMDP 框架中，同构对称性为每个分区中的智能体使用相同的因子模板。根据 E.1.1 节中的基础假设，交换同一分区内的智能体及其对应的动作和观察分配，会保持该分区中的计数不变，并且仅会重新排列相等的因子实例。因此，基础转移函数、共享奖励函数和观察函数均保持不变，从而形成计数对称性。当这些交换通过其中指定的可接受类型嵌入来表示时，它们就是各分量上的环境自同构，因而也是策略评估对称性。因此，提升后的分区进一步细化了结构化的智能体分区。然而，我们在附录 E.1.1 中展示的双智能体协调示例具有计数对称性和策略评估对称性，但对于包含一个分区的相同分区而言，却缺乏所陈述的重复加性奖励因子分解。仅凭策略评估对称性无法保证这种重复加性因子分解的存在。要应用 Braun 等人（2022）关于紧凑表示和智能体数量可处理性的结论，还需要满足他们提出的额外因子分解和计算假设。

paragraphs.en: An expected return symmetry (ERS) preserves the self-play-optimal Boltzmann policy set at a fixed positive temperature ( Muglich et al., 2025 ) , whereas policy-evaluation symmetry preserves complete evaluation for every decentralized policy. On the shared finite-horizon Dec-POMDP subclass and common admissible transformations, Proposition E.3 establishes that neither ERS nor initial-distribution-preserving policy-evaluation symmetry implies the other in general. The two non-implications are established using different models. For a particular model, the two symmetry sets may coincide or one may contain the other. Section E.2.1 presents the two counterexamples as evidence for these non-implications and states the additional local action-value condition linking the notions. ERS fixes agent indices, so it does not relate distinct agents or replace the structural agent types defined by our agent orbits.
paragraphs.zh: 期望回报对称性（ERS）在固定正温度下保持自博弈最优的玻尔兹曼策略集（Muglich 等，2025），而策略评估对称性则确保对每个去中心化策略的完整评估。 在共享有限时间步 Dec-POMDP 子类及通用可接受变换上，命题 E.3 指出，一般而言，ERS 与初始分布保持型策略评估对称性之间不存在相互蕴含关系。 这两种非蕴含关系是通过不同模型确立的。 对于特定模型，这两种对称性集合可能重合，也可能一个包含另一个。 第 E.2.1 节通过两个反例证明了上述非蕴含关系，并提出了连接这些概念的额外局部动作价值条件。 ERS 固定了智能体索引，因此它既不能关联不同的智能体，也不能替代由我们的智能体轨道所定义的结构化智能体类型。

paragraphs.en: The initial distribution specifies how possible starting states are weighted when an episode begins. It is therefore part of standard POSG and Dec-POMDP formulations ( Bernstein et al., 2002 ; Hansen et al., 2004 ) . A related separation appears in PlaNet’s latent state-space model, which distinguishes an initial latent state from the transition, observation, and reward models used to generate a rollout ( Hafner et al., 2019 ) . Structural causal models offer a useful motivation: their structural equations describe transition functions, while a distribution over exogenous variables of structural equations represent background factors that imply substantive characteristics affecting behavior ( Pearl, ) . Here, the initial distribution is corresponding to the exogenous distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 初始分布指定了在一集开始时，各种可能的初始状态如何被加权。 因此，它是标准 POSG 和 Dec-POMDP 公式的一部分（Bernstein et al., 2002；Hansen et al., 2004）。 PlaNet 的潜在状态空间模型中也存在一种类似的分离：该模型将初始潜在状态与用于生成展开过程的转移、观察和奖励模型区分开来（Hafner et al., 2019）。 结构因果模型提供了一个有用的动机：其结构方程描述了转移函数，而结构方程中外生变量的分布则代表了影响行为的实质性特征的背景因素（Pearl,）。 在这里，初始分布对应于外生分布。

paragraphs.en: Componentwise symmetries have concrete uses. paragraphs.en: Proposition 5.3 gives the concrete separation. Its agent transformation changes some entries of the transition distribution, so it fails the componentwise test. The changed distributions nevertheless have the same expected successor-state reward and marginalized next-observation distribution, which are the quantities used by the Bellman evaluation in that construction. The policy-evaluation identity therefore holds for every decentralized policy. Two agents share a structural agent type if an admissible transformation connects them and preserves policy evaluation for every joint policy, even without preserving each model component. Conversely, componentwise preservation remains an additional, potentially finer diagnostic of where agents differ in the environment representation.
paragraphs.zh: 命题 5.3 给出了具体的分离方法。 其智能体变换会改变转移分布中的某些条目，因此无法通过逐分量测试。 然而，这些被改变的分布具有相同的期望后继状态奖励和边际化下一观测值分布，而这些正是该构造中贝尔曼评估所使用的量。 因此，策略评估恒等式对每个去中心化的策略都成立。 如果一种可接受的变换能够将两个智能体连接起来，并且在无需保留每个模型分量的情况下，仍能保持所有联合策略的策略评估结果，那么这两个智能体就共享一种结构智能体类型。 反之，逐分量的保持不变性仍然是一种额外且可能更精细的诊断方法，用于识别智能体在环境表示上的差异所在。

paragraphs.en: Learning mechanisms concern behavioural policies, so it must be considered when talking about agent heterogeneity, which lets us introduce the policy equivariance. For example, exploration noise whose distribution does not respect the action transformation can violate the equivariance of an already equivariant policy. This will not change agent heterogeneity, because policy-evaluation symmetry requires the evaluation identity to hold for every decentralized policy. This makes the agent heterogeneity decided by the evaluation identity independent of the learning mechanism that is applied to obtain the target policies (that geniunely describes the agent heterogeneity). Thus, our policy-evaluation symmetry can capture intrinsic characteristics of an agent to categorize its agent type.
paragraphs.zh: 学习机制涉及行为策略，因此在讨论智能体异质性时必须将其纳入考虑，这使我们能够引入策略等变性。 例如，探索噪声的分布若不遵循动作变换，就可能破坏一个原本具有等变性的策略的等变性。 这不会改变智能体异质性，因为策略评估对称性要求评估恒等式对每个去中心化策略都成立。 这使得由评估恒等式决定的智能体异质性，与用于获取目标策略的学习机制无关（而后者才真正描述了智能体异质性）。 因此，我们的策略评估对称性能够捕捉智能体的内在特征，从而对其类型进行分类。

paragraphs.en: Dec-POMDPs are a long-standing model of cooperative sequential decision-making under partial observability, in which decentralized agents optimize a common reward ( Bernstein et al., 2002 ) . A common reward removes differences between the agents’ reward functions, but it does not guarantee interchangeable action or observation spaces, or symmetric roles in the transition and observation distributions. Section 6 therefore shows that shared objectives need not imply structural homogeneity. This extension helps connect the objective to physical and environmental perspectives, as deifned by prior work ( Bettini et al., 2023 ) , by assessing their structural significance through one policy-evaluation symmetry criterion.
paragraphs.zh: Dec-POMDPs 是一种长期存在的合作式序列决策模型，适用于部分可观测性场景，其中去中心化的智能体共同优化一个共享奖励（Bernstein et al., 2002）。 共享奖励消除了不同智能体的奖励函数之间的差异，但并不能保证动作空间或观察空间的可互换性，也无法确保转移分布和观察分布中角色的对称性。 因此，第 6 节表明，共享目标并不必然意味着结构上的同质性。 这一扩展有助于将目标与物理和环境视角联系起来（如先前的研究（Bettini et al., 2023）所定义），通过一项策略评估对称性标准来评估其结构性意义。

paragraphs.en: Social dilemmas ( Dawes, 1980 ) illustrate how individually rational behavior can lead to collectively inferior outcomes, even when cooperation could benefit every player. This motivates mechanisms that support cooperation, with social welfare ( Roughgarden and Tardos, 2002 ) providing a criterion for evaluating the resulting collective benefits. Social welfare is defined as the sum of individual payoffs, which well matches our definition of the aggregate common reward in Section 6 . Theorem 6.1 and its examples show that replacing individual rewards by an aggregate common reward can preserve, remove, or create policy-evaluation symmetries. This provides a novel perspective from structural agent types, in contrast to previous work that identifies game structures ( Leibo et al., 2017 ) , to understand the effect of maximizing social welfare to social dilemmas.
paragraphs.zh: 社会困境（Dawes，1980）说明了个体理性行为如何可能导致集体次优的结果，即使合作本能使每个参与者受益。 这促使人们设计支持合作的机制，其中社会福利（Roughgarden 和 Tardos，2002）为评估由此产生的集体收益提供了标准。 社会福利定义为个体收益之和，这与我们在第 6 节中对总体共同奖励的定义高度一致。 定理 6.1 及其示例表明，用总体共同奖励取代个体奖励可以保留、消除或产生策略评估的对称性。 这从智能体的结构类型角度提供了一种新的视角，与先前识别博弈结构（Leibo 等，2017）的研究形成对比，从而有助于理解最大化社会福利对社会困境的影响。

paragraphs.en: In cooperative MARL for solving Dec-POMDPs, the centralised training and decentralised execution (CTDE) paradigm ( Oliehoek et al., 2011 ) is proposed to collectively optimize a global value function that approcimates the cumulative common rewards. There are a class of algorithms that proposed to represent the gloabl value function as aggregation of individual values, e.g., VDN uses additive decomposition ( Sunehag et al., 2018 ) ; SQDDPG and SHAQ use Shapley-based value decompositions ( Wang et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2022 ) ; and QTRAN learns an additive transformation of the joint action-value function that preserves its optimal actions ( Son et al., 2019 ) . As those formulations and the learning paradigm are well aligned with each agent j j optimizing V j , t π ; ℳ w ​ ( x ) = ∑ i ∈ N w i ​ V i , t π ; ℳ ​ ( x ) V_{j,t}^{\pi;\mathcal{M}_{w}}(x)=\sum_{i\in N}w_{i}V_{i,t}^{\pi;\mathcal{M}}(x) , Theorem 6.1 motivates a testable hypothesis: do these algorithms implicitly learn structural agent types, which could be an inductive bias for improving cooperation?
paragraphs.zh: 在解决决策部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（Dec-POMDP）的合作式多智能体强化学习（MARL）中，提出了集中训练与分散执行（CTDE）范式（Oliehoek 等人，2011），以集体优化一个全局价值函数，该函数用于近似累积的共同奖励。 有一类算法被提出，旨在将全局价值函数表示为个体价值的聚合形式，例如，VDN 使用加法分解（Sunehag 等人，2018）；SQDDPG 和 SHAQ 使用基于沙普利值的价值分解（Wang 等人，2020；Wang 等人，2022）；而 QTRAN 则学习对联合动作价值函数进行加法变换，同时保留其最优动作（Son 等人，2019）。 由于这些公式与学习范式高度契合——每个智能体 j 都在优化 V_{j,t}^{\pi;\mathcal{M}_{w}}(x) = \sum_{i\in N}w_{i}V_{i,t}^{\pi;\mathcal{M}}(x)，定理 6.1 提出了一个可检验的假设：这些算法是否在隐式地学习结构化的智能体类型，而这种类型可能成为提升合作能力的归纳偏置？

paragraphs.en: We use every element of G ℳ eval G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} to form orbits: two agents i i and j j belong to the same structural agent type when some g ∈ G ℳ eval g\in G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} satisfies σ g ​ ( i ) = j \sigma_{g}(i)=j . For example, let N = { 1 , 2 , 3 } N=\{1,2,3\} and consider the induced agent permutations σ g \sigma_{g} that fulfil the cyclic permutation 1 ↦ 2 ↦ 3 ↦ 1 1\mapsto 2\mapsto 3\mapsto 1 . Repeated applications of these permutations can map any agent to any other, so the subgroup it generates acts transitively on N N . This subgroup therefore induces the same single-part orbit partition { N } \{N\} as Sym ⁡ ( N ) \operatorname{Sym}(N) , although it contains only three of the six possible agent permutations, as contained in Sym ⁡ ( N ) \operatorname{Sym}(N) . In contrast, a different and much stronger condition is that every agent permutation ξ ∈ Sym ⁡ ( N ) \xi\in\operatorname{Sym}(N) be induced by some g ∈ G ℳ eval g\in G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} satisfying σ g = ξ \sigma_{g}=\xi . This full-permutation condition is the dynamic analogue of name-irrelevant symmetry in normal-form games ( Cao and Yang, 2018 ) . It is stronger than structural homogeneity, as we defined in Section 4 . As explained after Definition 4.2 , structural homogeneity requires only that, for every pair i , j ∈ N i,j\in N , some g ∈ G ℳ eval g\in G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} satisfies σ g ​ ( i ) = j \sigma_{g}(i)=j . The induced agent-permutation group { σ g : g ∈ G ℳ eval } \{\sigma_{g}:g\in G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}}\} may therefore be a proper subgroup of Sym ⁡ ( N ) \operatorname{Sym}(N) . By the definition of stuctural partition, the structural agent types of Sym ⁡ ( N ) \operatorname{Sym}(N) may overclaim the exact structural agent types that can be obtained from G ℳ eval G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} .
paragraphs.zh: 我们利用 G ℳ eval G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} 中的每个元素来构造轨道：当存在某个 g ∈ G ℳ eval g\in G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} 满足 σ g ​ ( i ) = j \sigma_{g}(i)=j 时，两个智能体 i 和 j 就属于相同的结构智能体类型。 例如，令 N = { 1 , 2 , 3 } N=\{1,2,3\}，并考虑满足循环置换 1 ↦ 2 ↦ 3 ↦ 1 1\mapsto 2\mapsto 3\mapsto 1 的诱导智能体置换 σ g \sigma_{g}。 重复应用这些置换可以将任何智能体映射到任何其他智能体，因此它们生成的子群对 N N 具有传递作用。 因此，该子群与 Sym ⁡ ( N ) \operatorname{Sym}(N) 诱导了相同的单部分轨道划分 { N } \{N\}，尽管它仅包含 Sym ⁡ ( N ) \operatorname{Sym}(N) 中六个可能的智能体置换中的三个。 相比之下，一个不同且更强的条件是：每个智能体置换 ξ ∈ Sym ⁡ ( N ) \xi\in\operatorname{Sym}(N) 都必须由某个 g ∈ G ℳ eval g\in G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} 诱导，且满足 σ g = ξ \sigma_{g}=\xi。 这种全置换条件是正常式博弈中名称无关对称性的动态对应形式（Cao 和 Yang，2018）。 它比我们在第 4 节中定义的结构同质性更强。 如定义 4.2 之后所解释的，结构同质性仅要求：对于每一对 i , j ∈ N i,j\in N，都存在某个 g ∈ G ℳ eval g\in G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} 满足 σ g ​ ( i ) = j \sigma_{g}(i)=j。 因此，诱导的智能体置换群 { σ g : g ∈ G ℳ eval } \{\sigma_{g}:g\in G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}}\} 可能是 Sym ⁡ ( N ) \operatorname{Sym}(N) 的一个真子群。 根据结构划分的定义，Sym ⁡ ( N ) \operatorname{Sym}(N) 的结构智能体类型可能会过度声称从 G ℳ eval G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} 中可以获得的确切结构智能体类型。

sents.en: We use every element of G ℳ eval G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} to form orbits: two agents i i and j j belong to the same structural agent type when some g ∈ G ℳ eval g\in G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} satisfies σ g ​ ( i ) = j \sigma_{g}(i)=j .
sents.zh: 我们利用 G ℳ eval G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} 中的每个元素来构造轨道：当存在某个 g ∈ G ℳ eval g\in G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} 满足 σ g ​ ( i ) = j \sigma_{g}(i)=j 时，两个智能体 i 和 j 就属于相同的结构智能体类型。

sents.en: For example, let N = { 1 , 2 , 3 } N=\{1,2,3\} and consider the induced agent permutations σ g \sigma_{g} that fulfil the cyclic permutation 1 ↦ 2 ↦ 3 ↦ 1 1\mapsto 2\mapsto 3\mapsto 1 .
sents.zh: 例如，令 N = { 1 , 2 , 3 } N=\{1,2,3\}，并考虑满足循环置换 1 ↦ 2 ↦ 3 ↦ 1 1\mapsto 2\mapsto 3\mapsto 1 的诱导智能体置换 σ g \sigma_{g}。

sents.en: Repeated applications of these permutations can map any agent to any other, so the subgroup it generates acts transitively on N N .
sents.zh: 重复应用这些置换可以将任何智能体映射到任何其他智能体，因此它们生成的子群对 N N 具有传递作用。

sents.en: This subgroup therefore induces the same single-part orbit partition { N } \{N\} as Sym ⁡ ( N ) \operatorname{Sym}(N) , although it contains only three of the six possible agent permutations, as contained in Sym ⁡ ( N ) \operatorname{Sym}(N) .
sents.zh: 因此，该子群与 Sym ⁡ ( N ) \operatorname{Sym}(N) 诱导了相同的单部分轨道划分 { N } \{N\}，尽管它仅包含 Sym ⁡ ( N ) \operatorname{Sym}(N) 中六个可能的智能体置换中的三个。

sents.en: In contrast, a different and much stronger condition is that every agent permutation ξ ∈ Sym ⁡ ( N ) \xi\in\operatorname{Sym}(N) be induced by some g ∈ G ℳ eval g\in G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} satisfying σ g = ξ \sigma_{g}=\xi .
sents.zh: 相比之下，一个不同且更强的条件是：每个智能体置换 ξ ∈ Sym ⁡ ( N ) \xi\in\operatorname{Sym}(N) 都必须由某个 g ∈ G ℳ eval g\in G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} 诱导，且满足 σ g = ξ \sigma_{g}=\xi。

sents.en: This full-permutation condition is the dynamic analogue of name-irrelevant symmetry in normal-form games ( Cao and Yang, 2018 ) .
sents.zh: 这种全置换条件是正常式博弈中名称无关对称性的动态对应形式（Cao 和 Yang，2018）。

sents.en: It is stronger than structural homogeneity, as we defined in Section 4 .
sents.zh: 它比我们在第 4 节中定义的结构同质性更强。

sents.en: As explained after Definition 4.2 , structural homogeneity requires only that, for every pair i , j ∈ N i,j\in N , some g ∈ G ℳ eval g\in G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} satisfies σ g ​ ( i ) = j \sigma_{g}(i)=j .
sents.zh: 如定义 4.2 之后所解释的，结构同质性仅要求：对于每一对 i , j ∈ N i,j\in N，都存在某个 g ∈ G ℳ eval g\in G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} 满足 σ g ​ ( i ) = j \sigma_{g}(i)=j。

sents.en: The induced agent-permutation group { σ g : g ∈ G ℳ eval } \{\sigma_{g}:g\in G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}}\} may therefore be a proper subgroup of Sym ⁡ ( N ) \operatorname{Sym}(N) .
sents.zh: 因此，诱导的智能体置换群 { σ g : g ∈ G ℳ eval } \{\sigma_{g}:g\in G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}}\} 可能是 Sym ⁡ ( N ) \operatorname{Sym}(N) 的一个真子群。

sents.en: By the definition of stuctural partition, the structural agent types of Sym ⁡ ( N ) \operatorname{Sym}(N) may overclaim the exact structural agent types that can be obtained from G ℳ eval G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} .
sents.zh: 根据结构划分的定义，Sym ⁡ ( N ) \operatorname{Sym}(N) 的结构智能体类型可能会过度声称从 G ℳ eval G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} 中可以获得的确切结构智能体类型。

paragraphs.en: The above conclusion is important in applications. Suppose the same stochastic model governs sensor disturbances or physical obstacles for symmetric agents. These factors can be described by symmetries not included in G ℳ eval G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} , and different realized outcomes by those extra symmetries do not by themselves intrinsically change the agent structural types. However, separating stable structures from temporary perturbations, or equivalently, determine a proper subgroup of Sym ⁡ ( N ) \operatorname{Sym}(N) , would require deeper investigation.
paragraphs.zh: 上述结论在应用中具有重要意义。 假设相同的随机模型支配着对称智能体的传感器扰动或物理障碍物。 这些因素可以通过 G ℳ eval G_{\mathcal{M}}^{\mathrm{eval}} 中未包含的对称性来描述，而由这些额外对称性产生的不同实现结果本身并不会内在改变智能体的结构类型。 然而，要将稳定结构与临时扰动区分开来，或者等价地确定 Sym ⁡ ( N ) \operatorname{Sym}(N) 的一个适当的子群，则需要更深入的研究。

paragraphs.en: The present framework assumes finite state, action, and observation spaces, a finite horizon, empty initial histories, exact expected-value evaluation, and the complete domain of decentralized behavioral product policies without shared randomness. Its structural types are relative to the specified POSG, the chosen evaluation semantics, and the declared admissible transformation group. Because ℛ adm ​ ( ℳ ) \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{adm}}(\mathcal{M}) is declared by the modeller, candidate transformations must be justified independently of the desired heterogeneity conclusion. Restricting this group can refine the structural partition, while enlarging it can coarsen the partition.
paragraphs.zh: 当前框架假设状态、动作和观察空间是有限的，时间范围有限，初始历史为空，期望值评估精确，且包含无共享随机性的去中心化行为产品策略的完整域。 其结构类型与指定的 POSG、所选的评估语义以及声明的可接受变换群相关。 由于 ℛ adm ​ ( ℳ ) \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{adm}}(\mathcal{M}) 由建模者声明，候选变换必须独立于所期望的非均匀性结论进行论证。 限制该群可以细化结构划分，而扩大该群则会使划分变得粗略。

paragraphs.en: We provide sufficient conditions and finite examples to clarify the policy-evaluation symmetry and the resulting agent heterogeneity, but no general symmetry-discovery or verification algorithm is introduced. Also, exact orbits given by policy-evaluation symmetries do not measure degrees of heterogeneity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提供了充分条件和有限示例来说明策略评估对称性及其导致的智能体异质性，但并未引入通用的对称性发现或验证算法。 此外，由策略评估对称性给出的精确轨道并不能衡量异质性的程度。

paragraphs.en: Infinite-horizon models and nonlinear or learned reward aggregation require separate formulations. The weighted construction is a forward result for fixed linear weights. It does not recover individual rewards from a supplied common reward or cover nonlinear aggregation.

paragraphs.en: Policy-evaluation symmetry compares expected values. It can therefore treat two transformations as symmetric even when they induce different distributions over trajectories or returns, provided those differences do not change the expected values. Distributional evaluation ( Bellemare et al., 2017 ) or risk-sensitive evaluation ( Chow et al., 2015 ) may further distinguish such transformations. Finally, our results do not prove the existence of an optimal equivariant policy, or establish representation, evaluation and sample-complexity improvements.
paragraphs.zh: 策略评估的对称性比较的是期望值。 因此，即使两种变换在轨迹或回报上引发了不同的分布，只要这些差异不会改变期望值，它们就可以被视为对称的。 分布评估（Bellemare 等人，2017）或风险敏感评估（Chow 等人，2015）可能进一步区分这类变换。 最后，我们的结果并未证明存在一个最优的等变策略，也未确立在表示、评估和样本复杂度方面的改进。

paragraphs.en: All those above boundaries establishes clear routes for further research to improve our framework. Besides, with proper task formalizations, our framework may also inform research on multi-agent world models ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) and large language models (LLMs) ( Wu et al., 2023 ) by separating structural differences between agents.
paragraphs.zh: 上述所有界限为后续研究确立了明确的路径，有助于改进我们的框架。 此外，通过适当的任务形式化，我们的框架还可能通过区分智能体之间的结构性差异，为多智能体世界模型（Zhang 等人，2025）和大型语言模型（LLMs）（Wu 等人，2023）的研究提供指导。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares prior categories and measures of agent heterogeneity to different levels of our framework. The two approaches ask different questions. Existing taxonomies primarily identify where agents differ, such as in their physical capabilities, observations, dynamics, objectives, or selected policies. Our framework instead asks whether an admissible transformation can exchange the agents while preserving complete policy evaluation. The correspondences are therefore conditional interpretations rather than equivalences between definitions.

Consequently, componentwise preservation supplies a sufficient test for agents to share a structural agent type, but failure of a componentwise preservation equation for one candidate transformation does not establish that their structural types differ. paragraphs.en: Bettini et al. ( Bettini et al., 2023 ) describe physical heterogeneity through differences in hardware or physical constraints, such as sensors, actuators, and motion constraints. Our framework can classify such differences only through their representation in the POSG. Different sensors may appear in the observation spaces or observation distribution, different actuators may appear in the action spaces or transition distribution, and motion constraints may appear in the state and transition distribution. If action or observation spaces have different cardinalities, the required typed bijection does not exist. Equal cardinality permits a bijection between differently named spaces, but it does not by itself place the resulting complete transformation in the application-specified admissible group. Thus, the formal comparison concerns the modeled consequences of a physical difference rather than hardware identity itself. A physical property that is not represented in the POSG lies outside the structural classification.
paragraphs.zh: Bettini 等人 (Bettini 等人，2023) 通过硬件或物理约束（如传感器、执行器和运动约束）的差异来描述物理异质性。 我们的框架只能通过 POSG 中的表示来对这类差异进行分类。 不同的传感器可能出现在观察空间或观察分布中，不同的执行器可能出现在动作空间或转移分布中，而运动约束则可能出现在状态和转移分布中。 如果动作空间或观察空间的基数不同，则所需的类型双射并不存在。 相等的基数允许在不同命名的空间之间建立双射，但这本身并不会使由此产生的完整变换落入应用指定的容许群中。 因此，形式上的比较关注的是物理差异所导致的建模后果，而非硬件本身的同一性。 未在 POSG 中表示的物理属性位于结构分类之外。

sents.zh: 我们的框架只能通过 POSG 中的表示来对这类差异进行分类。

sents.en: Different sensors may appear in the observation spaces or observation distribution, different actuators may appear in the action spaces or transition distribution, and motion constraints may appear in the state and transition distribution.
sents.zh: 不同的传感器可能出现在观察空间或观察分布中，不同的执行器可能出现在动作空间或转移分布中，而运动约束则可能出现在状态和转移分布中。

sents.en: If action or observation spaces have different cardinalities, the required typed bijection does not exist.
sents.zh: 如果动作空间或观察空间的基数不同，则所需的类型双射并不存在。

sents.en: Equal cardinality permits a bijection between differently named spaces, but it does not by itself place the resulting complete transformation in the application-specified admissible group.
sents.zh: 相等的基数允许在不同命名的空间之间建立双射，但这本身并不会使由此产生的完整变换落入应用指定的容许群中。

sents.en: Thus, the formal comparison concerns the modeled consequences of a physical difference rather than hardware identity itself.
sents.zh: 因此，形式上的比较关注的是物理差异所导致的建模后果，而非硬件本身的同一性。

sents.en: A physical property that is not represented in the POSG lies outside the structural classification.
sents.zh: 未在 POSG 中表示的物理属性位于结构分类之外。

Our closest test combines the typed observation maps ϕ g , i 𝒪 \phi_{g,i}^{\mathcal{O}} with the joint observation-preservation condition in Equation ( 6 ). paragraphs.en: The core POSG in Section 3 does not assume this agent-level decomposition. It specifies an undivided state space 𝒮 \mathcal{S} and one global transition distribution P ⁡ ( s ′ ∣ s , a ) , P(s^{\prime}\mid s,a), without canonically assigning coordinates of s s to individual agents or attributing parts of the transition law to particular update mechanisms. Consequently, a difference in an agent’s own next-state distribution and a difference in its influence on other next-state components both appear as differences in the same global distribution. Equation ( 5 ) can test whether that entire distribution is preserved by a candidate type-compatible transformation. If the equation fails, however, the undivided representation does not reveal whether the failure arose from response dynamics, effect dynamics, or both. Thus, the two categories have the same closest counterpart in our core model only in this representational sense. They are not treated as equivalent concepts.
paragraphs.zh: 第 3 节中的核心 POSG 并未假设这种智能体层面的分解。 它定义了一个未分割的状态空间 𝒮 \mathcal{S} 和一个全局转移分布 P ⁡ ( s ′ ∣ s , a ) , P(s^{\prime}\mid s,a)，但未将 s 的坐标按规范方式分配给各个智能体，也未将转移定律的部分内容归因于特定的更新机制。 因此，某个智能体自身下一状态分布的差异，以及它对其他下一状态分量的影响差异，都表现为同一全局分布中的差异。 方程 (5) 可用于检验候选类型兼容的变换是否保留了整个该分布。 然而，如果该方程不成立，这种未分割的表示方式无法揭示失败是源于响应动态、效应动态，还是两者兼有。 因此，只有在这种表示意义上，这两类概念在我们核心模型中才有相同的最近对应物。 它们并未被视作等价的概念。

A candidate transformation must then map each local state component and transition factor to the corresponding component and factor for the target agent. A response-preservation test compares the factors that generate s i ′ s_{i}^{\prime} and s σ g ​ ( i ) ′ s_{\sigma_{g}(i)}^{\prime} . An effect-preservation test instead compares the factors for the remaining agents and environmental state insofar as those factors depend on ( s i , a i ) (s_{i},a_{i}) and ( s σ g ​ ( i ) , a σ g ​ ( i ) ) (s_{\sigma_{g}(i)},a_{\sigma_{g}(i)}) , respectively. This additional structure is application-specific and, in general, cannot be recovered uniquely from P P alone. For example, two robots exhibit a response difference if the same drive command under corresponding conditions produces different distributions over their own next velocities. paragraphs.en: Hu et al. ( Hu et al., 2026 ) compare agents’ conditional reward distributions, while Bettini et al. ( Bettini et al., 2023 ) distinguish behavior under a shared objective from behavior under different objectives. The closest componentwise test under our deterministic transition-reward convention is the exact reward-preservation condition in Equation ( 7 ). It compares the reward functions after the agent, state, and action labels have been transformed, rather than requiring the functions to be identical under their source labels. Failure of this condition excludes that particular componentwise environment automorphism but does not, by itself, establish different structural agent types.
paragraphs.zh: Hu 等人 ( Hu 等人，2026 ) 比较了智能体的条件奖励分布，而 Bettini 等人 ( Bettini 等人，2023 ) 则区分了在共享目标下的行为与在不同目标下的行为。 在我们确定的转移-奖励约定下，最接近的分量测试是方程 (7) 中的精确奖励保持条件。 该测试比较的是在智能体、状态和行动标签被转换后的奖励函数，而不是要求这些函数在其源标签下完全相同。 若该条件不满足，则排除了特定的分量环境自同构，但仅凭这一点并不能确定存在不同的结构性智能体类型。

paragraphs.en: Section 6 also shows that a common reward function does not imply structural homogeneity. In a Dec-POMDP, all agents have equal value coordinates under the same policy and state–joint-history input, but they need not be exchangeable in their action spaces, observation spaces, or roles in the transition and observation distributions. Conversely, forming an aggregate common reward can preserve, remove, or create policy-evaluation symmetries, depending on the individual rewards and aggregation weights. Objective heterogeneity and structural heterogeneity are therefore related but distinct properties.
paragraphs.zh: 第 6 节还表明，一个共同的奖励函数并不意味着结构上的同质性。 在 Dec-POMDP 中，所有智能体在相同策略和状态–联合历史输入下具有相同的价值坐标，但它们的动作空间、观察空间或在转移和观察分布中的角色不必是可交换的。 相反，构建一个聚合的共同奖励可能会根据个体奖励和聚合权重来保留、消除或创造策略评估对称性。 因此，目标异质性和结构异质性是相关但不同的属性。

paragraphs.en: For example, consider two agents in mirrored roles. One agent may turn right after observing an obstacle on its left, while the corresponding rule for the other agent is to turn left after observing an obstacle on its right. The rules are equivariant if the game symmetry exchanges the agents and the left–right labels. If a selected policy fails the displayed equality for this transformation, it breaks that particular game symmetry and expresses a policy-relative behavioral difference. This does not change the structural agent types, which are defined from complete policy evaluation for every policy. Nor does failure for one transformation prove that the agents are unrelated at the policy level, because another policy-evaluation symmetry may both preserve the selected policy and exchange them.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，考虑两个角色互为镜像的智能体。 一个智能体在观察到左侧有障碍物后可能会向右转，而另一个智能体的对应规则则是在观察到右侧有障碍物后向左转。 如果游戏对称性交换了这两个智能体以及左右方向标签，那么这些规则就是等变的。 如果所选策略未能通过该变换所对应的等式检验，则意味着它打破了这一特定的游戏对称性，并表现出一种与策略相关的行为差异。 这并不会改变智能体的结构类型，因为这类类型是根据对每种策略的完整评估来定义的。 同样，某一次变换的失败也不能证明这两个智能体在策略层面上毫无关联，因为另一种策略评估对称性可能既保留所选策略，又交换这两个智能体。

paragraphs.en: Braun et al. (2022) formulate counting symmetry and isomorphic symmetry for partitioned Dec-POMDPs. Counting symmetry makes the transition, common-reward, and observation functions invariant to within-partition permutations of action and observation assignments. Equivalently, those functions depend on the assignments only through their per-partition histograms. Isomorphic symmetry additionally requires these functions to factor into repeated identical templates and therefore implies counting symmetry after grounding, whereas the converse need not hold. Thus, the two notions constrain the Dec-POMDP model functions and, for isomorphic symmetry, their factorization. By contrast, applying our more general POSG definition to the resulting grounded Dec-POMDP gives a condition on its complete policy-evaluation operator: it requires ℰ ℳ ​ ( g ⋅ π ) = g ⋅ ℰ ℳ ​ ( π ) \mathcal{E}_{\mathcal{M}}(g\cdot\pi)=g\cdot\mathcal{E}_{\mathcal{M}}(\pi) for every decentralized policy.
paragraphs.zh: Braun 等人 （2022）为分区的 Dec-POMDP 提出了计数对称性和同构对称性的定义。 计数对称性使得转移函数、共同奖励函数和观察函数对于动作与观察分配在分区内部的排列保持不变。 等价地，这些函数仅通过各分区的直方图来依赖分配情况。 同构对称性还要求这些函数可分解为重复的相同模板，因此在地基化后必然包含计数对称性，但反之则未必成立。 因此，这两种对称性概念对 Dec-POMDP 模型函数以及在同构对称性情况下对其分解方式施加了约束。 相比之下，将我们更通用的 POSG 定义应用于由此得到的地基化 Dec-POMDP，可得出对其完整策略评估算子的一项条件：对于任何去中心化的策略 π，必须满足 ℰ ℳ ​ ( g ⋅ π ) = g ⋅ ℰ ℳ ​ ( π ) \mathcal{E}_{\mathcal{M}}(g\cdot\pi)=g\cdot\mathcal{E}_{\mathcal{M}}(\pi)。

paragraphs.en: Here, grounding instantiates the lifted factor templates for the individual agents. Isomorphic factorization creates identical copies of the same factor structure for all agents in each part of the lifted partition. Permuting agents within a part therefore only reorders identical factors, so the grounded transition, common-reward, and observation functions can be represented using within-partition counts. This is counting symmetry. The arrow is one-way: counting symmetry can hold even when the grounded model does not arise from the same repeated isomorphic factorization.
paragraphs.zh: 在此，接地过程为各个智能体实例化了提升后的因子模板。 同构分解会为提升划分中每个部分的所有智能体创建相同因子结构的完全相同的副本。 因此，在一个部分内置换智能体只会重新排列相同的因子，所以接地后的转移、共同奖励和观察函数都可以用部分内的计数来表示。 这就是计数对称性。 这种关系是单向的：即使接地模型并非源于相同的重复同构分解，计数对称性仍然可能成立。

paragraphs.en: The proposition gives two counterexamples over the common model class. It does not claim that both set differences are nonempty for every fixed Dec-POMDP. In ℳ a \mathcal{M}_{a} , the uniform policy is the unique self-play-optimal Boltzmann policy. A within-agent action relabeling fixes this singleton set but changes the return of a deterministic policy outside Π α \Pi^{\alpha} . It is therefore an ERS transformation but not a policy-evaluation symmetry. In ℳ b \mathcal{M}_{b} , a within-agent observation relabeling satisfies the value-transformation identity in Definition 4.1 for every decentralized policy after transforming the policy and local histories. However, it exchanges observations with different conditional local action-value gaps, so it maps the unique Boltzmann policy to a policy that violates Boltzmann consistency.
